description: This file defines macros and inline functions for a generic, typed vector data structure in C, including creation, initialization, reservation, push, pop, clearing, and deallocation operations.

methods.name: vector_<name>_init
methods.description: Initializes a vector structure by setting data pointer to NULL and sizes to zero.

methods.name: vector_<name>_alloc
methods.description: Allocates memory for a new vector structure.

methods.name: vector_<name>_clear
methods.description: Clears the vector, optionally releasing each element, then frees data memory and reinitializes.

methods.name: vector_<name>_free
methods.description: Frees the vector structure and its data, after clearing.

methods.name: vector_<name>_reserve
methods.description: Reserves capacity for at least p more elements.

methods.name: vector_<name>_push
methods.description: Adds an element to the end of the vector, resizing if necessary.

methods.name: vector_<name>_pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the last element from the vector, asserting if empty.
